about: Radio Jolene: how the voices SAY things (SND-RADIO-3, G1700-G1702). "say" respells a word for the voice only (the text, the lint and the fallback keep the spelling); "titles" is the spoken-title map - each catalogue track as a person says it, the store-listing words dropped (tools/audio/radio_gen.js derives a missing one and writes it here; edit freely); "artists" likewise for the credit line. radio_gen.js writes the back-announces from these; prep_voice.js applies "say".
